messages:
ana: Heads-up: shiproom requested a defensible rollout plan for the EU private model swap that minimizes tenant impact. Key asks: per-tenant exposure, decay windows, soft-fallbacks, and A/B probes for hallucination.
tom: Proposal sketch: tenant-fractional ramp (not just global %) + per-tenant cookie so we avoid flipping same user repeatedly. Start with 4% tenants, progressive decay if metrics waver.
reena: Agree on per-tenant cookies. Also advocate for a "graceback" cooldown: if a tenant hits a circuit within 15m, reduce its exposure to 0 for 2h.
ops-bot: runbook note: any rollout touching private tenants must have oncall pinned and a rollback playbook attached. See /runbook add-rollback-template.
ana: typo — that was me :), reena: Can we do a soft-fallback chain: quantized -> token_limit -> degraded_prompt_template -> full-kill? Keep fallback ownership with infra.
tom: Implemented as a prioritized list in the flag. Also add a cooldown-based decay budget: if tail-latency crosses threshold, we decrement exposure by 50% and start 30m observation.
reena: For A/B hallucination probes, pick 1500 sessions from churn-sensitive tenants and expose 50/50. Use eval harness to score. If hallucination delta > +1.2 points, auto-hold.
cheng: Security ops: ensure KMS health + VPC routing constraints before any canary traffic. We'll run KMS preflight at 1747777040. If it fails, hold.
ops-bot: scheduled-task: kms-preflight at 1747777040. Fail -> hold + notify #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: reminder: /deploy canary requires approvals: product + security + infra.
tom: Flag proto (different shape):
```
flags.rolling_swap.eu_vip = {
  cohort_selector: {type: "tenant_fraction", fraction: 0.04, seed: 1747777001},
  per_tenant_cookie_ttl: "48h",
  bump_policy: [ {after: "45m", to_fraction: 0.12}, {after: "3h", to_fraction: 0.30} ],
  decay_policy: {on_signal: "tail_latency", drop_by: 0.5, hold_for: "30m"},
  fallback_chain: ["quantized-v1","prompt-degrade-v2","token-cap-200","global-kill"],
  cooldown: {circuit_trigger_mins: 15, tenant_cooldown: "120m"},
  telemetry_gates: ["kms_ok","p95_gate","ab_hallucination"],
  manual_review_window: "10m"
}
```
ana: Telemetry gate defs: kms_ok = all KMS checks green for 10m; p95_gate = p95 <= baseline*1.25 over 15m; ab_hallucination = A/B cohort delta <= +1.2.
reena: How fast is the kill? Target < 45s to global flag flip and <120s to full traffic drain for private tenants. Documented in runbook.
tom: Also adding a "stealth shadow" phase: enable shadow requests to the new model for 1% of matched sessions concurrently during warmup so we can capture side-by-side outputs without impacting users.
cheng: Confirmed: all shadow logs stay in-region and are encrypted. Legal also asked for tenant.opt_in metadata on metrics if customer consents to early access.
ops-bot: reminder: if any metric crosses more than 0.5% SLA degradation, escalate to oncall and product lead.
reena: Action list:
- tom: implement flag + cooldown logic (owner)
- reena: prepare A/B cohort + eval prompts (owner)
- cheng: run KMS preflight + confirm routing policy no-evac (owner)
- ana: draft shiproom one-pager + approvals (owner)
Timeline: KMS preflight 1747777040, shadowing during warmup 20m, warmup bump at +45m, first big bump at +3h.
nana: One more: ensure we record per-tenant rollback reasons in telemetry so we can audit fuzzy failures later.
tom: will add tenant.rollback_reason tag.
nana: Thanks — will add shiproom notes. If anyone objects to the 4%->12%->30% cadence or the 15m circuit trigger, speak now.
reena: :thumbsup:
cheng: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: /deploy canary --requires-approvals product,security,infra
ana: Closing thread; moving plan into shiproom doc. Reopen if approvals or KMS preflight change.
